chars.MOM: a Moroccan woman about 50, round kind face, wearing a mustard-yellow djellaba and a plain white headscarf
chars.NEIGHBOUR: an elegant Moroccan woman about 35, long dark wavy hair, wearing a wine-red tailored blazer over a cream blouse, black trousers, a gold watch
chars.SON: a Moroccan young man about 24, short black hair, light stubble, wearing a grey hoodie with one green stripe across the chest and black joggers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from a half-open doorway of a modern Casablanca apartment living room: MOM leans close to NEIGHBOUR on a Moroccan sofa over mint tea glasses, whispering with a hand beside her mouth and pointing toward the hallway, gossiping eagerly; NEIGHBOUR listens with raised eyebrows. Head-to-waist framing, both faces clearly visible, warm afternoon light, 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: SON lies bored on his bed in a small messy bedroom in Casablanca scrolling job ads on his phone, a pile of printed CVs on the desk, sighing, 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: MOM and NEIGHBOUR laughing together like old friends in the apartment stairwell landing, NEIGHBOUR holding a plate of Moroccan cookies MOM gave her, warm friendly mood, 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: NEIGHBOUR alone stepping out of her apartment door with a leather handbag and car keys, confident and independent, no ring on her hand, modern Casablanca building hallway, 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In the living room, NEIGHBOUR speaks seriously with one hand raised as if making an offer, MOM's face lights up with surprise and joy, mint tea on a low table, 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: NEIGHBOUR in a glass-walled modern office of a big company in Casablanca, standing as a boss pointing at an empty desk with a computer, staff working in the background, 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In the apartment kitchen MOM, hands on hips, firmly tells SON to go and work, SON sits at the table eating bread with a sulky face, 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: MOM shouting comically and waving a wooden spoon at SON who leans back with wide eyes and raised hands, funny family scolding in a Moroccan kitchen, 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: SON in his bedroom grinning widely and pumping his fist with excitement, looking in the mirror while fixing his hoodie, happy daydreaming mood, 2D animated cartoon style.
